title: Kenyan Italian Frittata
description: A unique blend of Italian and Kenyan flavors in this Italian-style omelette. The pungent flavor of the molten cheese adds a rich twist to this meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs together and season with salt and pepper.
Add the grated molten cheese to the eggs and stir to combine.
Add the chopped pungent herbs to the eggs and stir to combine.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the frittata is set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
Optional: Serve with a side of Kenyan-style vegetables, such as sautéed spinach or roasted sweet potatoes.
